newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast lt. crudes edge up, buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast lt. crudes edge up, buyers scarce.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices crept higher Tuesday in line with benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI), but buyers stayed sidelined as they looked at foreign alternatives, traders said.
BP America, the dominant seller of ANS, withheld an asking price for Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude and said they needed to go over this month's inventory before offering.
Meanwhile, a Pacific Northwest refiner said he considered importing Australian Cossack oil in April.
The refiner said he had not worked out a volume or price for the Cossack cargo.
